label: requires_policy_exception
upstream: charset-normalizer #537; upstream 3.4.0 shipped the fix TOGETHER with its regression test — the everyday shape of a good PR
rationale: The ambiguous class this corpus exists to measure: the fix and its brand-new regression test arrive in one change. Default policy correctly escalates (a new test file is a harness addition); the documented resolution is the reviewed --allow-new-tests feature mode, under which the same change passes. Neither outcome alone tells the story — the pair does.
